# Draft:European Capital of Culture Nova Gorica Gorizia - GO!2025

----
Under the title “GO! Borderless”, Nova Gorica from Slovenia and Gorizia from Italy became the first cross-border European Capital of Culture in the history of the initiative. They have used the title-year as a vehicle to give visibility to the combined heritage of a modernist city and a thousand-year-old city, transcending their boundaries on a journey of reconciliation from difficult history.
Programme has questioned the concept of borders from multiple dimensions under the slogan “Go! Borderless” and lasted from 8 February to 5 December when the title of European Capital of Culture was handed from Nova Gorica, Gorizia and Chemnitz to the cities of Trenčín (Slovakia) and Oulu (Finland).
